coverage: public state-storage conformance with real SQLite files, stable empty versions, initialize winner, immutable address-scoped operations, expiry tombstones, commit validation and restart
record, reverse index/revision and operation receipt roll back together on failed receipt insertion

lost accepted response reconciles the same operation; held accepted save remains on original owner after actor switch

legacy_extraction: Prior factory body preserved byte-for-byte except explicit function name, injected binding and type-only binding import; legacy settings and slot names retained. All 31 legacy tests pass.
database: SDK-owned connection; Bun SQLite API-compatible test binding with explicit statement cleanup. Not an actual running-host database.

macro_boundary.limits: No live plugin, native search service, mailbox, deployment or chat/model history was read or changed.

limits: No Slack/GitHub/Macro adopter implementation or mapping import/cutover; no new credentials, mailbox/search access, runtime activation or workspace gitlink promotion.
